profileSummary.text: Fullstack engineer with 1+ year of production experience on meeting-processing and IoT products. Works across backend services in Node.js, Go, and Python with PostgreSQL and the web and mobile interfaces on top of them, including integration and production troubleshooting inside a cross-functional team.

projects.narrative: Meeting product that turns recordings into summaries and action items. Built upload, progress feedback, and recovery after interrupted uploads across web and mobile.
Open-source AI workspace for non-developers: an orchestrator delegates to specialist AI roles, and work is accepted only when checks prove it. Built with Go and Svelte.

employmentBullets: Built recording upload and progress-feedback flows for Sensio Notes across web and mobile, including recovery after interrupted uploads.
Built backend and control-feedback flows for Sensio IoT, connecting user commands to device state, and worked on application reliability.
Implemented UI/UX designs as working web and mobile features and worked with AI and IoT engineers on integration.
Diagnosed application failures and supported testing and releases with infrastructure and security engineers.
employmentSummary: Backend and fullstack development for meeting-processing and IoT products, in a cross-functional team of AI, IoT hardware, infrastructure, security, and UI/UX engineers.
